notes.title: New Review System and Sale.
notes.notes:
Thanks for buying Bezier. Hopefully you're having a blast. Steam are currently jiggling with their review system. Reviews help potential players considering a purchase and the more reviews a game gets the more players are made aware of it via Valve's super secret algorithms.

If you haven't already, if you could leave a review that would be amazingly helpful. Many many many thanks to those of you who already have. 

Finally, both the game and the soundtrack are currently on sale.

Happy blasting.

notes.title: Soundtrack Now Available
notes.notes:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/456560/

The original soundtrack to Bezier. 22 tracks spanning over 70 minutes. Provided in high quality 320kbps MP3 format. The soundtrack mixes orchestral, synthesizer, vocal and solo instruments within 15 game tracks. One for each four minute zone in campaign mode. 

The soundtrack of Bezier was composed by Philip Bak between 2008 and 2010. It was engineered and produced by Matt Rhodes & Matt Howe at Pinewood Studios using ProTools running through a Vintage Neve 5315 console. 

You can listen to the soundtrack here: https://soundcloud.com/niinegames/sets/bezier.

notes.title: A new Endurance mode...
notes.notes:
Today I have overhauled how the Endurance mode worked.

As you progress through the 100 waves the difficulty of the game increases. At Wave 100 you will be getting hit 10 times harder than you did at Wave 1.

That's the stick. Here is the carrot.

To counter this, as you move through the waves, a constantly increasing score multiplier will run alongside this difficulty ramp. At Wave 100 you will be scoring 10 times the points you were at Wave 1.

So, the mode quickly gets a lot harder, but the points you can score in those higher Waves is HUGE.

Happy blasting.

notes.title: Welcome to Bezier
notes.notes:
Hello you,

Thanks for stopping by. It has been a long road but my first game is finally finished and released. Heartfelt thanks to everyone who has helped me out along the way.

It's my birthday too, so I'm now off to the pub. See you later.
